subject.title: fix(agents): reject invalid bundled LSP framing

question: Should bundled LSP sessions fail closed on malformed framing, headers above 8 KiB, or bodies above 64 MiB using the limits proposed by this PR?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but selecting hard framing limits and immediate child termination intentionally changes behavior for previously tolerated or unusually large server output.

options.title: Accept bounded fail-closed framing
options.body: Merge with the proposed limits because valid ordinary LSP traffic remains unchanged while invalid or pathological output can no longer stall the session or grow buffers indefinitely.

options.title: Adjust limits before landing
options.body: Keep the fail-closed parser but choose different header or body thresholds based on known bundled language-server requirements.

options.title: Retain permissive compatibility
options.body: Do not land this approach if preserving malformed or exceptionally large server output is more important than bounded memory and immediate failure reporting.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fail-closed framing
recommendation.body: Merge with the proposed limits because valid ordinary LSP traffic remains unchanged while invalid or pathological output can no longer stall the session or grow buffers indefinitely.
